mgmt_bio.text: Eddie Yongming Wu, also known as Wu Yongming, has served as chief executive of Alibaba Group since September 2023, a role he took on after decades inside the company he helped create as one of its original 19 co-founders. He joined as Alibaba's first programmer in 1999, later held chief technology officer roles across several of the group's businesses, led the Taobao and Tmall platforms, and founded the venture capital firm Vision Plus Capital. He studied engineering at Zhejiang University of Technology. As CEO, he has centered Alibaba's strategy on a heavy push into artificial intelligence and cloud computing, with an emphasis on AI infrastructure and models.
